answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 14341 Country: India Title: my father is sending me for haj this year. haj is not farz on me. if i perform the haj farz will be ada or when haj will become farz i have to go again. Question: my father is sending me for haj this year. haj is not farz on me. if i perform the haj farz will be ada or when haj will become farz i have to go again. Answer ID: 14341 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1088/1088=M/1430) If your father bears all expenses of your hajj and you perform the same, your hajj will be valid as fardh . You will not be required by Shariah to perform hajj again when in future you will be able to do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
